classifications.name: Certification
classifications.description: Governance certification level for datasets and dashboards.

tags.name: Certified
tags.description: Approved for business reporting and dashboard consumption.

tags.name: Candidate
tags.description: Useful but pending stewardship or metric review.

tags.name: Deprecated
tags.description: No longer recommended for new analytics work.

classifications.name: DataSensitivity
classifications.description: Business sensitivity classification for NordForge data assets.

tags.name: Operational
tags.description: Internal operational data with process context.

tags.name: Confidential
tags.description: Sensitive commercial, customer, finance, or promise data.

classifications.name: Lifecycle
classifications.description: Lifecycle state for data products and BI assets.

tags.name: WorkbookOnly
tags.description: Present in workbook documentation but intentionally excluded from CSV ingestion.

tags.name: SeededDemo
tags.description: Seeded starter asset requiring production replacement.

classifications.name: BusinessCriticality
classifications.description: Importance of an asset to company operations.

tags.name: Essential
tags.description: Required for daily operational decision making.

glossary.name: NordForgeBusinessGlossary
glossary.description: Business terms for NordForge ERP, operations, BI, and governance assets.

terms.name: ATP
terms.description: Quantity that can be promised to customers after allocation and blocked-stock rules.

terms.name: OTIF
terms.description: Delivery performance measure showing whether shipments were on time and complete.

terms.name: BlockedStock
terms.description: Inventory withheld from customer promise because of quality, label, compliance, or investigation reasons.

terms.name: ContractPricing
terms.description: Customer or customer-group pricing terms, discounts, rebates, and validity windows.

terms.name: FreightAudit
terms.description: Process for checking carrier invoices, accessorial charges, rate-card compliance, and accruals.

terms.name: CertifiedDataset
terms.description: Dataset approved by a steward and suitable for recurring business reporting.

terms.name: DataProduct
terms.description: Governed package or mart with owner, purpose, freshness expectations, and lineage.

terms.name: Lineage
terms.description: Relationship showing where data originates, how it is transformed, and which assets consume it.

policies.name: certified_dataset_review_policy
policies.description: Certified datasets require named owner, documented grain, metric definitions, and monthly review.
rules: Certification.Certified assets must have owner and domain.
Gold BI datasets must define at least one metric and one dimension.

policies.name: confidential_commercial_data_policy
policies.description: Commercial, customer promise, freight finance, and customer-service assets are confidential by default.
rules: SQL Lab or ad hoc access requires BI steward approval.

policies.name: workbook_only_exclusion_policy
policies.description: Workbook-only documentation tabs are cataloged but excluded from CSV ingestion products.
rules: Lifecycle.WorkbookOnly tables cannot be treated as loadable CSV facts.
Workbook-only assets must retain lineage to their source package.

policies.name: dashboard_certification_policy
policies.description: Executive and operational dashboards require certified datasets and business-owner review.
rules: Executive dashboards require Data Platform and business-owner review.
Dashboard metrics must reconcile to data product contracts or governed marts.

lineage.description: Use ATP constraints before confirming customer order dates.
Reconcile stock holds and movement postings with customer availability.
Connect confirmed orders to delivery OTIF outcomes.
Tie delivery performance to freight cost and audit findings.
Apply contract pricing and discount controls to order fulfillment analysis.
Route constrained availability to the right account/service team.
